warnings: Grid NAMES come from the architectural ground-floor plan A-09 (หน้า10), the only sheet that prints bubbles: 1-17 along x and A-E along y. The structural plans S-02..S-06 print the same dimension rows with ticks but no bubbles; their geometry agrees with A-09 on every value read (op01 precedence: structural geometry, A-09 only names it).

x: 16 bays x 4.00 = 64.00 (total printed on S-02, A-09). y: A-B 2.50, B-C 5.50, C-D 2.50 (A-D 10.50 and A-C 8.00 printed as totals on S-02), D-E 4.00 (E = the stair-entrance projection rows at grids 4-5 and 13-14). Origin A1 (top-left as drawn).

Dummy lines (rule 4 + beam endpoints). x: before the origin, sharing grid 1's prime sequence in reading order — 1' -3.50 (outer walkway edge, A-09), 1'' -2.20 (roof eave, S-06), 1''' -1.50 (end cantilever / slab edge), 1'''' -0.50 (GX/BX stub); 3' 8.50 and 3'' 10.50 / 5' 17.50 and 5'' 19.50 (left entrance projection, A-09 chain 2.00/1.50/4.00/1.50/2.00 — 3'' and 5' carry the S-04 R1 beams); 12' 46.50 and 14' 53.50 (right entrance projection); after 17: 17' 64.50, 17'' 65.50, 17''' 66.20, 17'''' 67.50. y: A' -3.50, A'' -2.20 (eave), A''' -1.50 (cantilever edge), A'''' 1.10 (GY/BX stub); B' 5.45 (lower B3, floors 2/3), B'' 6.07 (G3, floor 1); D' 12.00 (cantilever edge / B13), D'' 12.50 (floor-3 stair bump), D''' 12.70 (eave); E' 16.00 (entrance projection edge).

B'/B'' come from the stair sections, not from a plan: S-14 (and the S-13 upper flight) print 2.55 + 2.95 between the row-C beam and the row-B B3, so the lower B3 of floors 2/3 sits at 8.00 - 2.55 = 5.45 (B'); S-13 prints 'ประมาณ 1.93m' + 3.57 (= 5.50) for the floor-1 G3, also printed 1.93 on the S-15 G6 elevation, so G3 sits at 8.00 - 1.93 = 6.07 (B''). B'' carries lower confidence because the value is printed as approximate.

Sweep scope (what was actually read for dimensions): structural plans S-02, S-03, S-04, S-05, S-06 (all rows); beam elevations of S-15..S-21 that run along a grid axis (G6, G7, G10/1-G10, G11, B7-B8, B9/1-B9, B10, B11/1-B11, B12, B14, B15, R8/1-R8 — those whose bays are ambiguous (B2, R7, R3/R4, R6, R13/R14) are in unassigned_dimensions); stair sections S-13/S-14; steel-roof truss elevations S-22; prefab-roof sheets PT-02/PT-03; levels from A-05 (datum, fill +0.30) and A-13 section 1-1 (floor levels + its y rows); A-09 ground-floor plan for the grid bubble names and its left (to grid 3), right (from grid 9) and entrance-bay rows only. NOT swept: other rows of A-09, the architectural plans/elevations/sections A-10..A-12, A-14..A-33, EE/SN/F sheets (op04 Pass 3), and element-internal dimensions of S-07..S-12 (they live on the elements).

New ticks: y 11.50 (A-11 1.00 from D to the stair-bump window wall, both halls), 12.75 and 15.25 (A-10 0.75 strips at the entrance canopy, from D' 12.00 and E' 16.00). 12.75 lies 0.05 from the eave line 12.70 (S-06/A-13 2.20) — different edges (canopy gutter vs roof eave), both kept per rule 4.
